backend_test_report.checkout: current working tree, including uncommitted changes

limitations: Every AI reference decision abstains: 16 insufficient_evidence, 4 requires_human_review; no adequate class coverage.
Required/relevant evidence is selected spans, not an exhaustive relevance inventory.
Citation entailment and clinical accuracy are not measured.
Agent exact unit-level scope mismatch recall is zero against four selected annotated keys.
Contradiction gold is not exhaustively reviewed; contradiction performance is not measured.
Agent sees iterative retrieval and full snapshots; RAG and keyword see one BM25 top-20 retrieval.
Heldout was exposed to the AI annotator and is only a family-separated technical set.
Earlier failed RAG attempts remain preserved; replay success is not the overall success rate of all paid attempts.
Cost and reviewer time savings have not been measured.
